plugins.calendarPermission: Allow this app to add events to your calendar.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow this app to use your location while you use the app to share your position for live events.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow this app to access your location in the background so live event sharing stays active until you stop it or the event ends.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow this app to choose a photo for your profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow this app to take a photo for your profile picture.
